name: A morte do mundo nos teus olhos
description: It's the final week to catch this powerful painting exhibition by Avelino Sá. Don't miss your last chance to see this compelling body of work before it closes this Saturday.
longDescription:
"A morte do mundo nos teus olhos" is a painting exhibition by Avelino Sá, hosted at Galeria Fernando Santos. This presentation of Sá's recent works explores themes of contemporary existence and observation through his distinct artistic lens. The exhibition offers a collection of paintings that reflect on the world as perceived by the artist.

Visitors to the exhibition will encounter a series of paintings within the setting of Galeria Fernando Santos. The gallery provides a space for viewing the artworks, allowing for individual contemplation of the pieces. The exhibition is open to the public and is presented in a gallery environment.

The exhibition is free to attend. Galeria Fernando Santos is located in Porto, within walking distance of the Aliados metro station. The event concludes on Saturday, May 30, 2026.
